encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

κομιδῆ τεθνηκώς, τῶν ἀν᾽ ὀκτὼ τοὐβολοῦ

Antiphan. 140. Alexid. 189. Damox. 2, 28. sperat ea ratione (οὕτως 2) esurientem similiter in vitam rediturum esse ac redierit Tithymallus fabarum multitudine consumpta. de Tithymallo cf. Antiphan. 210. Aristophont. 10. Alexid. 159 et de quaesitis id genus antithetis (καρτερεῖν, ἀποκαρτερεῖν) Antiphan. 169. Anaxil. 9. Alexid. 7. 209. 3. ἀν᾽ ὀκτὼ τοὐβολοῦ, fabae quarum octoni modii obolo constant. 4. μαλάξας, i. e. postquam manducavit, comedit. non sibi prae inpatientia mortem fame conscivit, sed famem patienter pertulit. adesp. Mein. II 746, 10. 11 ὥστε μᾶλλον ἂν θέλειν ἀποκαρτερεῖν (fame se necare) ἢ ταῦτ᾽ ἀκούων καρτερεῖν.
